title: Squeaky's Fair Share: An Intro to Fractions!
tagline: Join Squeaky the squirrel to discover how fractions help us share yummy treats fairly and equally!
style_guide: Clean modern flat illustration, bold primary colors (red, blue, yellow on cream background), friendly mascot, minimal background, generous whitespace, soft drop shadows.
recurring_character_description: A happy, curious brown squirrel with a bushy tail and a little red backpack.

scenes.visual_prompt: Eye-level shot, bright studio lighting, cheerful inviting mood, clean modern flat illustration, bold primary colors with cream background, a happy, curious brown squirrel with a bushy tail and a little red backpack, holding a perfectly round, whole chocolate chip cookie, looking thoughtful.
scenes.audio_dialogue: Hey there, little learners! Meet Squeaky the squirrel. Squeaky has a super yummy cookie, but he wants to share it with his friend. How can we make sure they both get a fair piece?

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up shot, soft natural lighting, slightly disappointed mood, clean modern flat illustration, bold primary colors with cream background, a happy, curious brown squirrel with a bushy tail and a little red backpack, holding two clearly unequal pieces of a chocolate chip cookie, looking a bit sad.
scenes.audio_dialogue: Squeaky tries to break it, but oh no! One piece is big, and the other is tiny. That's not very fair, is it?

scenes.visual_prompt: Top-down view, warm studio lighting, triumphant happy mood, clean modern flat illustration, bold primary colors with cream background, a happy, curious brown squirrel with a bushy tail and a little red backpack, holding two perfectly equal halves of a chocolate chip cookie. A subtle dotted line indicates the original cut.
scenes.audio_dialogue: To share fairly, we need to cut the cookie into *equal* parts! When we cut something into two equal parts, each part is called a 'half'. And when we talk about parts of a whole, we're talking about fractions!

checkpoint.question: What do we call each part when a cookie is cut into two *equal* pieces?
checkpoint.explanation: That's right! When you cut something into two equal parts, each part is called a half. Fractions are all about those equal parts!

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot, cheerful sunny lighting, joyful celebratory mood, clean modern flat illustration, bold primary colors with cream background, a happy, curious brown squirrel with a bushy tail and a little red backpack, smiling broadly while holding one equal half of a chocolate chip cookie. The other half floats gently towards the edge of the frame, implying it's going to a friend.
scenes.audio_dialogue: See? Now Squeaky and his friend can both enjoy their delicious cookie, knowing they each got one equal half. Fractions help us share things fairly every time!

questions.question: What does Squeaky want to do with his yummy cookie?
choices: Share it fairly with a friend
questions.explanation: Squeaky is a good friend who wants to share his cookie fairly!

questions.question: When you cut something into equal pieces, what math idea are you using?
questions.explanation: Fractions help us understand and describe equal parts of a whole.

questions.question: If you cut an apple into two pieces, but one is much bigger than the other, are they 'halves'?
choices: Only if it's a red apple
questions.explanation: For something to be a 'half,' the parts must be exactly the same size.
